## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈700 recipes labelled Polish (region "Eastern European" 2,503); not released.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 407 recipes tagged `polish` (steps, nutrition, no amounts).
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 45 dishes (12 Poland-only; pierogi, racuchy, Toruń gingerbread); [[FmLAMA]] 38 dishes (588 rows; bigos, kopytka, mizeria); [[World Wide Dishes]] 6 (5 Poland-only; pierogi, cebularz). Ingredient lists only.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 162 plants; [[NPASS]] 587 pairs (6 species, 32 compounds), the second-highest country after China, i.e. a few intensively sampled species.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 117 rows (104 concentrations, 13 reproducibility).
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] ETHNOBOT 8 records; [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Polish FCT, no BLEnD file and no Polish recipe corpus with amounts.
